body:
Yes my website shows a webpage for each item in hierarchical menu. I can configure google analytics for all urls but that has some disadvantages.

1. Google likes clean and simple urls
2. Sending google a url like .../...?q=w\&p=0\&dFR\[brand]\[0]=XX\&dFR\[brand]\[1]=YY&.... does not seem a good opinion. This will also increase page views because this will send 5 views for a search like "q=white"

Maybe turbolinks can be a solution for this?
